Date: 2026-05-10T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in a deeper technical walkthrough following docs quickstart

Hi Marcus,

We just finished the Docs quickstart and spun up a small PoC against the Hosted API — great docs, thanks. We’re an early infra team building a chat-based search assistant and want a short technical session to discuss:

- recommended model variants for short context (500–1k tokens)
- best practices for KV/prefix caching and minimizing latency spikes
- options for private deployment / VPC (we have strict data controls)

Would your engineering team be able to do a 30–45 minute walkthrough next week? We’re PST (San Francisco) based — ideal slots for us are Tue/Wed mornings PT, but we can be flexible. I attached a quick usage screenshot and included our repo link below.

Thanks,

Taylor Reed
Senior Platform Engineer, Fathom Apps

Thanks for the note, Taylor — great to hear the quickstart went smoothly. I’ll loop in our SDR to lock a time and our docs/solutions engineer to ensure we cover the integration points you care about.

Vivek / Soojin — can you help coordinate a 30–45 minute tech call? Taylor prefers Tue/Wed mornings PT next week but is flexible. If helpful, we can cover model selection, caching patterns (prefix vs KV), and VPC options; I’ll bring our inference engineer and product PM.

Taylor — quick Q before we schedule: are you testing with short-lived session keys or embedding-only flows today? That’ll help us shape the walkthrough.

Cheers,

Answers to Marcus’s question: we started with short-lived session keys for dev, but will likely move to a server-side flow with persistent keys for production. We’re also evaluating whether to host private model endpoints later (compliance + latency reasons).

Two quick asks for the call:
1) Can your engineer share recommended token limits and batching guidance for 800–1000 token exchanges?
2) If possible, can we get a run-of-show showing what steps to take if we need to move from hosted -> private deployment later?

Thanks — Taylor
